The import pass bound that name to 0x00676e90 instead, whose live body takes two stack words and returns with RET 8. order: Return immediately when the manager gate byte at +0x24 is nonzero. No record is looked up and no mask is applied.
Call 0x00676660 with the manager in ECX and stack word one on the stack to obtain the definition record.
Test stack word three as a byte; a nonzero value branches to the set path at 0x00676eeb, zero to the clear path at 0x00676ef4.
Set path: read stack word two and execute OR dword ptr [EAX+0x4],ECX, a read-modify-write of the full 32-bit word.
Clear path: read stack word two, negate it with NOT, and execute AND dword ptr [EAX+0x4],EDX.
Return when record byte +0x00 bit 0 is clear, tested with TEST byte ptr [EAX],0x1.
Push the record and call 0x006751c0; a false AL returns.
Push stack word one, set ECX to the manager, call 0x00676710 and discard its AL.
Pop EDI, pop ESI and return with RET 0xc.
mechanics.write_order: The mask write is unconditional inside the gate and always precedes the flag-bit test, the comparator call and the forward. The comparator therefore observes the record after the mask has already been applied.
mechanics.flag_bit_propagation: Only record+0x00 bit 0 is consulted, and only after the mask write. The mask word at record+0x04 never participates in the gating decision.
mechanics.mask_semantics: The mask is a full 32-bit word. A zero mask is a no-op on both paths. A 0xffffffff mask sets the word to all ones on the set path and to zero on the clear path. The clear path negates the mask first, so bits outside the mask are preserved.
mechanics.set_flag_width: Stack word three is read as a single byte, so any nonzero low byte selects the set path; the upper three bytes are never examined.
mechanics.comparator_modes: The comparator at 0x006751c0 selects mode (flags >> 8) & 0x7 from the jump table at 0x00675230: mode 0 progress >= target, mode 1 target < progress, mode 2 progress == target, mode 3 progress < target, mode 4 progress <= target, mode 5 progress != target, modes 6 and 7 false. The mode encoding is owned by 0x006751c0; this package reproduces the encoding only inside its model test and claims no body for it.
mechanics.forward_result: The 0x00676710 return value is discarded, so a forward that reports failure is indistinguishable to the caller.
mechanics.key_identity: Stack word one is forwarded unchanged to the lookup and to the forward; the mask and the set flag are never mixed into the key.
mechanics.domain_separation: The mask edit is the only mutation the target performs. Lookup, threshold comparison and completion notification are all delegated. The target touches no event object, no communication queue, no serializer and no mission record.
